drug_information.description: Cocaine is a powerful stimulant derived from coca leaves. It is classified as a manufactured narcotic drug under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985. Unauthorized production, possession, sale, purchase, transport, storage and distribution are prohibited except where permitted for medical or scientific purposes.

small_quantity.source: Government of India Notification S.O. 1055(E), 19 October 2001

commercial_quantity.source: Government of India Notification S.O. 1055(E), 19 October 2001

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Prohibits unauthorized production, possession, sale, purchase, transport, storage and distribution of narcotic drugs.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Manufactured Drugs
